sentences.text: Today, we are going to learn how to speak English at work.
Whether you work in an office, a store, or a restaurant,
you need to use English for communication.
In this episode, you will learn how to introduce yourself at work,
common office phrases, how to ask for help and information,
how to answer phone calls, how to participate in meetings,
how to send professional emails, how to talk to your boss and colleagues,
how to be polite and professional.
When you start a new job or meet a new colleague,
I am the new marketing assistant.
I started working here last week.
I'm happy to be part of the team.
I look forward to working with you.
I just started working here as a customer service assistant.
I look forward to working with you.
Smile and make eye contact when introducing yourself.
It helps to make a good first impression.
In the workplace, you will need to interact with your colleagues,
Did you have a busy day?
Can you help me with this?
I'm not sure how to do this task.

Tip, always say thank you when someone helps you.
